revised_prompts: Photorealistic 1920x1080 landscape frame from a fixed safety-inspection camera mounted about 1.5 meters above the floor, showing a realistic parking garage with industrial vinyl surfaces, moderate backlight balanced by usable foreground fill. Moderate side view at closer inspection distance, natural perspective, realistic scale, enough surrounding context to judge body support. Perspective-illusion variation: one clearly visible adult actor standing upright behind a low barrier so the perspective makes the body appear close to the floor while the person remains upright. Normal non-alert scene, plausible unedited inspection-camera capture, subject clearly visible, practical clutter kept behind the subject, no foreground obstruction. Ordinary photographic detail, restrained contrast, not cinematic or advertising. No text, caption, watermark, logo, warning label, overlay, bounding box, arrow, circle, artificial annotation, training signs, simulation text, medical staff, ambulances, first-aid equipment, cones, instruction boards, or dataset labels.
